title: spergulastrum lanuginosum subsp. saxosum
intro: Spergulastrum lanuginosum subsp. saxosum, commonly known as Sax's Spergulastrum, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties that have been used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been traditionally used to treat digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery, due to its health benefits of soothing the digestive system and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Sax's Spergulastrum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
